```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(here)
library(glue)
library(rlang)
library(mirt)
library(rlevante)

source(here("02_score_data/02_fit_irt/irt_modular.R"), chdir = TRUE)
source(here("02_score_data/02_fit_irt/registry_helper.R"))
source(here("02_score_data/02_fit_irt/irt_helpers.R"))
```

```{r}
# read in all models in registry
mods <- list_models() |> load_models()

# extract model specifications from filenames
mods_coded <- mods |>
  mutate(file = str_remove(filename, "\\.rds$")) |>
  separate_wider_delim(file, names = c("task_dup", "itemtype", "nfact", "invariance"),
                       delim = "_", cols_remove = FALSE, too_few = "align_start") |>
  select(-task_dup) |>
  mutate(invariance = invariance |> replace_na(""))

mod_coefs <- \(mod_rec) {
  n_resp <- bind_cols(group = mod_rec@groups, mod_rec@data) |>
    pivot_longer(cols = -group, names_to = "item", values_to = "correct") |>
    filter(!is.na(correct)) |>
    count(item, group, name = "n_responses")
  model_vals(mod_rec) |>
    as_tibble() |>
    filter(group != "GROUP", item != "GROUP") |>
    select(group, item, name, value) |>
    pivot_wider(names_from = name, values_from = value) |>
    left_join(n_resp, by = join_by(group, item)) |>
    mutate(n_responses = n_responses |> replace_na(0),
           item = str_remove(item, glue("{item_sep}[0-9]+$"))) |>
    distinct() |>
    mutate(difficulty = -d / a1) |>
    arrange(difficulty)
}

all_coefs <- mods_coded |>
  mutate(coefs = map(mod_rec, mod_coefs)) |>
  select(task, model_set, subset, itemtype, nfact, invariance, coefs) |>
  unnest(coefs)

write_rds(all_coefs, here("02_scoring_outputs/all_coefs.rds"), compress = "gz")
```

```{r}
bad_d <- all_coefs |>
  filter_out(model_set == "multigroup_site") |>
  filter_out(subset == "overlap_items") |>
  filter(abs(difficulty) > 8) |>
  select(task, item, group, subset, a1, d, difficulty) |>
  mutate(across(where(is.numeric), \(x) round(x, 3))) |>
  distinct() |>
  arrange(difficulty) |>
  filter_out(task %in% c("sds", "tom", "math"))

bad_d |>
  # select(item, group) |>
  mutate(subset = subset |>
           replace_values("es-CO" ~ "pilot_uniandes_co_bogota, pilot_uniandes_co_rural"),
         group = if_else(group == "all", subset, group)) |>
  arrange(item) |>
  group_by(item) |>
  summarise(exclusion_datasets = paste(group, collapse = ", ")) |>
  write_csv("exclusions_a1.csv")
```
